shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，用袋装与厚膜布的组合同时讲清剂型和用量形态。
以手持撕袋瞬间加四行空白勾选位，让目标人群自我对号入座。
shots.textZone: lower-left third, four thin tick rows

shots.intent: 用凝胶珠与三枚空白标签位解释剂型机理，把结构讲成可信卖点。
shots.textZone: left column of blank hairline rows plus three right-edge pill slots

shots.intent: 用同框同光的双栏肤面状态差与虚线圈注，保留对照分镜结构而不给主张。
shots.textZone: two header bars above the panels

shots.intent: 用左右两态与箭头把厚白膜布贴敷后转为透明膜层的视觉过程一眼讲清。
shots.textZone: bottom rose bar with two state label slots

shots.intent: 四栏同构选款分镜让买家在剂型系列里自行对位，降低选择成本。
shots.textZone: top band headline slot plus four column tag blocks

shots.intent: 用阶梯台座组合与两枚空白印章框收口降风险，信任位全部留白待填。

style.backgroundSystem: one flat field per shot inside the blush-cream family: clean white #FFFFFF for packshots, soft blush #F7E6E4 and warm cream #F3EDE6 for info and scene screens, rose #EFD9D6 for comparison panels
style.direction: soft premium skincare commerce with a gel-texture hero language
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons and hollow seal frames in the accent rose #D99A93, no filled pictograms
style.lightingSystem: bright soft daylight studio light, broad front key with gentle fill, skimming side light for gel texture, soft contact shadows, never harsh speculars
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium soft-lens skincare commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white background #FFFFFF, soft blush field #F7E6E4, dusty rose accent #D99A93 and warm charcoal text #3A3232; neutral bright studio lighting with a broad front key, gentle fill and skimming side light for gel texture, soft contact shadows and no harsh speculars; one flat background field per shot inside the blush-cream family; modern geometric sans-serif label slots with hairline rules and rounded pill tags; thin single-weight line icons and hollow seal frames only; gel surfaces read wet, translucent and lightly glossy with visible edge thickness; stable slight 3/4 product angle and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no ranking or review badges.
noDrift: no ranking, review or sold-count badges
style.presentationRules: pouch stays upright at a stable slight 3/4 scale across the set; gel sheet always shows its cut eye, nose and mouth slits and its edge thickness; skin is cropped at cheek, jaw or collarbone so no identity remains
style.surfaceSystem: matte warm pedestal and counter surfaces in cream #F3EDE6 and blush #F7E6E4, wet translucent gel domes as the recurring material note
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif for label slots only, hairline rules and rounded pill tags, every claim carried as a placeholder slot
